build_optical_flow_model: build a RAFT model instance with configurable dropout and correlation parameters for optical flow estimation
run_optical_flow_forward: run the RAFT forward pass to estimate optical flow between two image frames with iterative refinement
create_flow_initialization: create initial coordinate grids for optical flow computation at 1/8 resolution of input image
upsample_flow_field: upsample the flow field from H/8xW/8 to full HxW resolution using learned convex combination mask
freeze_batch_norm: freeze all batch normalization layers in the RAFT model by setting them to eval mode
